purpose: Three exploratory middle-aged bearded male base candidates. No base selected; no atlas application.

variants.name: 묵직한 족장
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Design ONE new BASE AXE CHARACTER candidate for the same Korean tower-defense game as the supplied sword portrait. Input is STYLE, SCALE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY, not the person to copy. The new man must be clearly MIDDLE-AGED around 45-50, with an abundant BUSHY FULL BEARD and thick connected moustache covering jaw and chin, mature forehead and eye-corner creases, heavy brows, a strong masculine nose and experienced eyes. A human warrior, not a dwarf, not a young clean-faced boy with a glued-on beard, not an old white-haired Santa. Preserve the reference's polished hand-painted 2D anime game illustration, fine clean dark outlines, detailed shaded hair and cloth, compact chest-up portrait scale. No photorealism, no 3D, no pixel art. Common comparison colors for all three candidates: medium-dark chestnut BROWN scalp hair AND BROWN beard/moustache, RED irises. Comparable simple charcoal tunic, sturdy plain dark-brown leather shoulder strap and modest gray fur collar, one plain iron axe partly visible behind a shoulder. No crown, helmet, bear hood, war paint, rune tattoos, scars, face mask or magic effects. Make the man rugged and cool but readable and handsome. SAME straight-on upright posture, straight-on gaze and shoulder height as the reference. Square 1254x1254 composition: keep the eyes near (525,590) and (717,584), nose at (620,650), natural hidden chin around y777; the extra beard may hang below the chin toward y900 without shrinking the face. Maintain the same underlying facial scale and substantial visible upper chest. Do not auto-fit the head smaller because the beard is wide or long. A flat lower-chest crop at y1136; keep a little clear space for the caption below it. Very pale warm gray plain background. Entire hair and axe silhouette inside canvas with padding. Only ONE character in each image, not a grid. No antenna-like hair curl in the middle of the forehead. This is a BASE CHARACTER exploration before class costumes; the variants should differ in face impression and hair/beard silhouette while clothing, palette, scale and lighting stay comparable. Candidate A: a dignified, imposing chieftain-like middle-aged axe warrior. Broad squared masculine face, heavy straight eyebrows, steady stern red-eyed gaze, a composed closed mouth mostly under the moustache. Thick chestnut hair brushed into a natural side part and tied low behind the head, visible forehead. A particularly dense broad rounded full beard with layered bushy cheek volume and a heavy full moustache, no pointed single braid. Strong quiet dependable presence. Exact bottom caption: "A · 묵직한 족장".
